subject: Marketplace private offer — SKU concordance & channel commission clarity
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@healthcore.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Marketplace private offer - channel commission & SKU packaging

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the intro last week — we reviewed Redwood in our procurement committee and would like to scope a private offer for HealthCore’s clinical analytics team. The RFP is attached. High-level asks: 

- We need a 12–18 month private offer covering GCP Marketplace and AWS Private Offers.
- Primary requirement: clear list-price + reseller pass-through that our distributor (MedNet Partners) can invoice against. They require a visible commission band.
- SKU mapping: we prefer a small-bundle SKU (analytics-core + 100k tokens) and an enterprise-bundle with priority support. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports SKU concordance (marketplace SKU <-> private-offer SKU)?
- Target discount: looking for ~30% off list across committed tiers, but open to structuring with uplift bands.

Can you share a preliminary packaging approach and recommended reseller margin so we can include in our procurement evaluation? Also open to a short call this week to walk the RFP.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Sr. Procurement Manager
HealthCore Systems
Attachments: HealthCore_RFP_2026.pdf
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@healthcore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Marketplace private offer - channel commission & SKU packaging

Hi Elena — thanks for the RFP and the clear asks. I’ve looped in Ben (channel/partner ops) to align on pass-through mechanics and SKU mapping. Quick answers up front: 

- SKU concordance: yes — Redwood’s private offer tooling can map private-offer SKUs to marketplace listing SKUs and publish equivalence in the offer metadata so distributors can invoice to the mapped SKU. We’ll include the SKU concordance section in the private-offer doc we share.
- Reseller margin guidance: our standard starting point for distributors is 12–18% net margin on list for committed private offers; for strategic distributor relationships we can model up to ~20–22% with additional conditions (co-marketing, minimum commit).
- Packaging approach: two recommended options below (I’ll attach a draft proforma SKU map):
  1) Compact Bundle: analytics-core + 100k token cap — list-priced/commit ladder; cleaner marketplace mapping, lower broker fee.
  2) Enterprise Bundle: analytics-core + higher token block + priority support — larger list price, supports tiered uplift and priority SLA add-on.

If HealthCore is targeting ~30% off list to the end customer, we typically model that as a mix of a 20% platform discount + up to 10% distributor pass-through (or equivalent combined concession). That preserves a visible list price for marketplace reporting while enabling your commercial target.

Can we do a 30-minute call tomorrow at 10:00 AM PT to go through the RFP and agree next steps? I’ll bring Ben and Irene for procurement and billing nuance.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Strategic Accounts — North America
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: FW: Request: Marketplace private offer - channel commission & SKU packaging — need channel margin / ops input

Forwarding HealthCore RFP (attached) — procurement wants a clear commission band for their distributor and SKU concordance across AWS/GCP. Quick asks I need from you both before I call Elena at 10am PT tomorrow: 

1) Target distributor margin to propose back to customer (list percentage). HealthCore has asked for ~30% off list to end customer; we should recommend a pass-through that keeps math clean for the distributor. 
2) Constraints on marketplace filings: any AWS/GCP cadence or evidence needed to publish SKU mapping? Are there timing lags we should call out? 
3) Invoice path and tax handling: if distributor invoices on our SKU mapped to marketplace listing, what fields do we need to preserve for MedNet Partners to reconcile?

Attached: sku_proforma_v2.xlsx (first pass). Below are my initial thoughts — please reply inline.

— Sofia

--- Inline notes from Ben Carter (added) ---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 11:18:00 -08:00

Sofia, quick notes inline: 
- Reseller margin: recommend starting with 15% net to distributor. HealthCore’s ask (30% off list) can be satisfied by a 17% platform discount + 13% distributor pass-through (example math attached). Allows room for co-marketing uplift to get to 20% effective distributor pay if needed.
- Marketplace filings: AWS Private Offers need SKU equivalence doc and a short lead time (usually 2–4 business days after we submit proforma). GCP Marketplace often requires the mapping entry in their partner portal and can be live in ~3–5 business days depending on listing changes. Call out a 7–10 business day buffer in the SOW for safety.
- Invoice path: require that distributor invoices include our platform SKU (Redwood SKU) and marketplace mapped SKU in metadata; need PO reference and customer org ID. We should provide a sample invoice template to MedNet.

Ben
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@healthcore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Marketplace private offer - channel commission & SKU packaging

Hi Elena — thanks for the patience while we pulled channel ops together. Per our call notes and the internal alignment below, summary and next steps: 

Summary (recommended commercial structure):
- SKU mapping: Redwood will publish SKU concordance for the Compact and Enterprise bundles across AWS/GCP. We will deliver the mapping file and confirm with marketplaces; expect 3–7 business days for full propagation.
- Pricing construct: propose to HealthCore a list-price framework with a combined effective ~30% off list to customer using: 17% platform discount + 13% distributor pass-through. (We can model alternate splits; see attached proforma.)
- Distributor margin: recommend 13% net to MedNet Partners as the initial pass-through. If HealthCore requires higher take, we can add up to +4% with co-marketing/commit conditions.
- Operational notes: MedNet needs to include both Redwood SKU and mapped marketplace SKU on invoices and POs; we’ll provide a sample invoice template. Include a 7–10 business day buffer for marketplace SKU propagation in the SOW.

Attachments: sku_proforma_v2.xlsx, redwood-private-offer-template.docx

Next steps: 
1) Sofia / Ben / Irene to share the formal private-offer doc (we’ll use the attached template) by EOD Friday.
2) HealthCore to confirm preferred split (platform vs distributor) and which bundle(s) to push as primary in procurement evaluation — can you confirm by next Tue (12/14)?
3) We’ll provision a draft DocuSign and marketplace mapping once HealthCore confirms the bundle selection.

If that looks good I’ll get the formal doc out Friday and schedule follow-ups to walk MedNet through the invoice template.

Best regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Strategic Accounts — North America
Redwood Inference
